pda.title: PDA Download (Android)
pda.hint: PDA packages (APK) — scan the QR code next to an entry to download
pda.emptyHint: Click "Upload APK" to upload a PDA package (Android install file).
pda.installHint: PDA install note: with the PDA on the same LAN as the server, scan the QR code next to an entry with the camera / scanner app to download. If the first install prompts "unknown sources" or "install blocked", grant the one-time permission: System settings → Apps → Special access (Install unknown apps) → find the browser → allow installing unknown apps; the exact entry point varies by brand (you can also long-press the browser icon → App info → Install unknown apps). For upgrades, use the APK distributed by the same server (matching signature allows a direct overwrite install; configuration and device ID are kept).
pda.uploadOk: APK "{{name}}" uploaded; PDAs can scan the QR code on this page to download and install.
